notes: Cognitive walkthrough (full four-question variant) of switch-dosing-to-manual. Record: .ui-evaluator/runs/20261007-002136-baseline-audit/cw/switch-dosing-to-manual.json. 3 steps walked; step 3 fails CW-Q4. Packet aria.json was empty; ARIA evidence from probe snapshots (probes/2, probes/6).

task_suitability.evidence: probes/2/probe.json: journey sequence passes; probes/6/probe.json: state reverts to automatic after reload

not_assessable: Whether the pumps themselves received the change to manual (black-box; no network failures were recorded)

strengths.title: Switching dosing off gives immediate, plain-language confirmation in place
strengths.evidence: probes/2/step-01.png: switch turns grey and the status line changes to 'Nutrient dosing is now manual: the pumps run only when you start them.' in the same panel, which answers the grower's 'does it take effect at once?' with 'now'.

candidates.title: Manual dosing reverts to automatic after the page reloads, with no cue that the change was temporary
candidates.description: A safety-relevant setting, once confirmed, should still show its confirmed state when the grower or a colleague looks again, or the screen should say the change was not kept. After switching to manual the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is now manual: the pumps run only when you start them.' After a reload of the same page the switch is on again and the status reads 'Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.' Nothing on screen (no time of change, no saved or applied indication, no pump state) distinguishes a lasting change from a temporary one.
candidates.impact: A volunteer about to drain the reservoir may believe the pumps are off while the shared tablet, after any reload, shows and may run automatic dosing; the pumps may then dose into an empty tank, and a grower who checks again cannot tell whether dosing ever stopped.

scope.persona: volunteer grower on evening shift, shared wall tablet

locations.snippet: Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.

evidence.detail: click switch -> wait 3 s -> screenshot (manual) -> reload -> expect status 'Nutrient dosing is now manual' FAILED; saw 'Nutrient dosing is automatic: pumps A and B top up to EC 1.8.'
journey sequence without reload passes; status 'Nutrient dosing is now manual' shown immediately

factor_notes.frequency: Every reservoir change (critical journey, regular frequency); the tablet is shared and wall-mounted, so reloads by other users or after wifi drop-outs are plausible.
factor_notes.impact: Grower sees success and leaves; the reversion is invisible unless they look again, and then unexplained.
factor_notes.persistence: Recurs on every reload; the grower cannot learn to avoid it because nothing signals it.

candidates.recommendation: Keep the dosing mode across reloads (store it with the controller, not the page), and show when and by whom it was last changed so a grower checking later can confirm it is still manual.
